app.title: Nebula Tarot
app.footer: UI shell for the Nebula Tarot MVP, aligned with the phase-2 design system.

auth.loginCopy: Sign in to restore your profile, preferences, and daily tarot flow.
auth.registerCopy: Set up your seeker profile, timezone, and daily reset rules before your first reading.
auth.usernameOptionalHint: Optional. If left blank, we'll use the part of your email before {'@'}.
auth.timezoneHint: Card of the Day resets at 3:00 AM in your local timezone.

validation.username: Username must be 3-20 characters and may include letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
validation.password: Password must be at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.

dashboard.copy: Reveal your deterministic card of the day, generate three-card spreads, and keep an eye on your retained reading flow.
dashboard.heroCopy: The backend reading engine is now connected to your protected dashboard. Daily card, three-card spread, and history states live here.
dashboard.loadingCopy: We are loading your latest readings and role-based tarot state.
dashboard.loadingSecondaryCopy: Daily card and spread history are being assembled from the backend.
dashboard.cardCopy: You can reveal one daily card per accounting day. If it already exists, the stored reading is returned.
dashboard.cardEmptyCopy: Reveal your card to anchor the day and lock in your deterministic reading until the next 3:00 AM reset.
dashboard.spreadCopy: Three-card spreads are generated with unique cards and limited by your current role policy.
dashboard.spreadEmptyCopy: Generate a spread to inspect your current path through the classic past, present, and future positions.

profile.title: Profile
profile.copy: Your role, timezone, theme, and language are already part of the shared application shell.
profile.accountCopy: Username and timezone are synced with the backend profile endpoint.
profile.preferencesCopy: Language and theme are saved through the settings endpoint and reflected in the shell.
profile.deckSettingsCopy: Choose your reading deck and card back independently. If you keep the system default, admin-level defaults will apply automatically.
profile.emailReadonly: Email is read-only in the MVP profile flow.
profile.roleReadonly: Role is assigned by platform policy and cannot be edited here.
profile.deckSettingsRestricted: Custom deck and card back selection is available only for adept, master, and keeper roles.

history.title: History
history.copy: Review retained daily cards and spreads, filter by reading type, and expand each entry for full detail.
history.loadingCopy: We are restoring retained readings and pagination state.
history.retentionInfo: Your role is {role}. History is kept for {retention_days} days, starting from {oldest_date}.
history.emptyCopy: Generate your first daily card or spread and it will appear here according to your role policy.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.copy: Operate users, reading limits, global rules, and the deck catalog from one protected keeper workspace.
admin.usersCopy: Search accounts, filter the list, update roles, and disable access when needed.
admin.decksCopy: Upload ZIP archives, validate deck structure, and manage the active deck catalog.
admin.policiesCopy: Tune daily spread limits and history retention for every role.
admin.settingsCopy: Control maintenance mode, registration flow, and default onboarding rules.
admin.emptyUsers: No users match the current filters.
admin.emptyCardBacks: No card backs are available yet.

userTable.title: Users
userTable.copy: {total} accounts found in the current scope.
userTable.selfGuardHint: Self-demotion and self-disable are blocked by the backend.

policyCard.copy: Changes apply to future reading behavior for users with this role.

settingsCard.messagePlaceholder: The ritual space is temporarily unavailable.
settingsCard.messageHint: Leave blank to keep the maintenance banner copy inactive until needed.

deckTable.title: Deck catalog
deckTable.copy: Uploaded decks appear here after ZIP validation and extraction.
deckTable.author: Author

cardBackTable.title: Card back catalog
cardBackTable.copy: Uploaded card backs are stored independently and can be assigned as the system default.

deckUpload.title: Create deck
deckUpload.copy: Upload one ZIP archive with all 78 cards. Card backs are managed separately.
deckUpload.structureHint: ZIP must contain only the major/minor folder structure with all 78 card images.
deckUpload.author: Author
deckUpload.descriptionPlaceholder: A mystical deck with celestial symbolism.
deckUpload.zipHint: The archive should contain only 78 card images. Allowed formats: PNG/JPG, max 2MB each, 2:3 aspect ratio.

validation.name: Provide at least one localized deck name.
validation.zip: Choose a ZIP archive before uploading.

cardBackUpload.title: Create card back
cardBackUpload.copy: Upload a standalone card back image that can be assigned independently from the deck catalog.
cardBackUpload.descriptionPlaceholder: A celestial back design for ritual spreads.
cardBackUpload.cropCopy: Choose the visible 2:3 area for the card back before upload.

validation.name: Provide at least one localized card back name.
validation.backImage: Choose a card back image before uploading.

dashboard.usersPanelCopy: Quickly inspect role distribution before jumping into detailed account management.
dashboard.readingsPanelCopy: Use these numbers to spot unusual volume and verify policy changes.
dashboard.decksPanelCopy: Deck status, upload readiness, and catalog growth are visible from one place.
dashboard.cardOfDayWeek: Card of the Day this week
